fixture_api_403_analysis.detail: GitHub API 403 blocked fixture lookups for 20/22 types when GITHUB_TOKEN was absent. However, all 9 published Cells examples use programmatic input (template_hints.input_creation_lines in cells.yml). The fixture registry's available=false for those files did not prevent generation.
fixture_api_403_analysis.note: No Cells scenario was blocked by fixture unavailability. The 403 affected fixture file discovery but not generation, since Cells uses synthetic/programmatic input.

can_cells_be_expanded.recommendation: Cells is functionally complete for all standalone LowCode APIs. Advanced provider_callback scenarios are possible but require significant planner/prompt system changes (multi-class generation). Not recommended as a priority.

synthetic_fixture_strategy_assessment.detail: template_hints.input_creation_lines in cells.yml creates valid XLSX input programmatically via Aspose.Cells Workbook API. This is sufficient for all 9 published converter/locker/merger/splitter examples.
